empty: The last statement returned no rows.

evidence.executed: PostgreSQL just ran {statements, plural, one {# statement} other {# statements}}, the last returned {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}. This is the result for this data and these statements, and says nothing about design quality.
evidence.executedMysql: MySQL just ran {statements, plural, one {# statement} other {# statements}}, the last returned {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}. This is the result for this data and statement, and says nothing about design quality.

notSimulated.explain: Not simulated yet: EXPLAIN is not built.

rebuildHint: Rebuild re-runs the {count, plural, one {# statement} other {# statements}} that succeeded earlier, in order. Statements with random results such as random() may produce different data this time.

stopped.cancelled: The running statement was cancelled. The PostgreSQL session was stopped, so data created by earlier statements is gone.
stopped.timeout: The statement took too long and was stopped. The PostgreSQL session was stopped, so data created by earlier statements is gone.
stopped.worker_crashed: The PostgreSQL session stopped unexpectedly, so data created by earlier statements is gone.

log.title: Run log
log.ran: Ran {n, plural, one {# statement} other {# statements}}.
log.escaped: The session role was changed, session rebuilt.
log.guardOff: The syntax check that blocks role changes could not start, only the after-run check remains.
log.rebuilt: Rebuilt, re-ran {n, plural, one {# statement} other {# statements}}.

parserDown: The syntax checker could not start, so errors are not marked while you type. You can still run; PostgreSQL will report real errors.
sampleAsk: Replace the SQL you are editing with the sample?

statements.title: {n, plural, one {# statement found} other {# statements found}}

stoppedMysql.cancelled: The running statement was cancelled. The MySQL session was cancelled, so data created by earlier statements is gone.
stoppedMysql.timeout: The statement took too long and was stopped. The MySQL session was cancelled, so data created by earlier statements is gone.
stoppedMysql.worker_crashed: The MySQL session stopped unexpectedly, so data created by earlier statements is gone.
